run_camofox_navigate: run camofox_navigate to navigate a Camoufox browser session to a specified URL
test_camofox_snapshot: test camofox_snapshot to retrieve an accessibility tree snapshot from the current browser tab
build_camofox_vision: build a vision analysis of a browser screenshot by calling camofox_vision with a question and optional annotation
refactor_camofox_session: refactor camofox session management to support managed persistence across agent restarts
review_camofox_click: review camofox_click to click a page element by its accessibility ref in the Camoufox browser
